rows.Description of 7DSGC game: Increases the damage dealt by a hero's skills and basic attacks. Core for offensive units.
Reduces incoming damage from enemy attacks. Essential for survivability, especially for tanks.
Represents a hero's total HP. When it reaches 0, the hero is defeated. Higher health allows heroes to withstand more damage.
Increases the amount of damage that ignores the enemy's defense, making attacks more effective against high-defense targets.
Decrease the amount of damage that ignores from Pierce Rate, Attack stats
Increases the effectiveness of healing ability of hero
The probability of an attack dealing critical damage. Higher chance leads to more frequent critical hits.
Increases the damage multiplier when a critical hit occurs, significantly boosting offensive output.
Reduces the chance of the hero receiving critical damage from enemies. Helps mitigate burst damage.
Reduces the amount of extra damage taken when the hero is hit by a critical attack. Enhances durability against critical hits.
Recovers a certain percentage of HP at the start of the hero's turn. Improves sustained survivability.
Converts a percentage of damage dealt into HP, allowing the hero to heal themselves through attacking.
The probability of a hero blocking an incoming attack, reducing the damage taken.
Increases the percentage of damage reduction when a block successfully occurs.
The chance for a hero to completely avoid an incoming attack, taking no damage and become MISS.
The chance for a hero to 100% HIT on upon attack
Increases the success rate of crowd control effects applied by the hero (e.g., stun, freeze, petrify).
The chance for avoiding negative debuff effects.
